label: GAPS6 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a GMT-encoded GAPS6 locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model, GAPS6__GAPS6a and GAPS6__GAPS6b, and experimentally linked to T7, T4, P1-vir, and lambda-vir protection when expressed in E. coli.
observations: GAPS6 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual GAPS6a or GAPS6b genes and proteins, the DefenseFinder GAPS6__GAPS6a and GAPS6__GAPS6b profiles, the GAPS6 source key, TPR repeats, PINc ribonuclease domains, PINc-domain activity outside a complete GAPS6 locus, phage protection outside a complete GAPS6 locus, RefSeq example loci without experimental validation, sibling GAPS1/GAPS2/GAPS4 systems, Gamma-Mobile-Trio islands as mobile elements, and other phage-defense systems.
